page_title: HEI 1-0 UNI | Heidenheim v Union Berlin 30/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+1' Substitution. Jan-Niklas Beste did his best and is replaced by Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim).
90+1' Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Here is a change. Eren Dinkci is going off and Frank Schmidt gives the last tactical orders to Florian Pick (Heidenheim).
90' Norman Theuerkauf goes off the pitch and Thomas Keller (Heidenheim) comes on.

88' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Kevin Muller!
87' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. Union Berlin have a free kick from a promising distance.
86' A pass by Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marvin Pieringer leaves the pitch and Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim) comes on.
81' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
78' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
78' Urs Fischer prepares a substitution. Lucas Tousart is replaced by Aissa Laidouni (Union Berlin).
78' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Alex Kral (Union Berlin).
77' The attendance for today's match is 15000.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) will replace David Datro Fofana.
74' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) for Robin Gosens.
74' Urs Fischer has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Union Berlin) replacing Leonardo Bonucci.
69' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
65' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Union Berlin, play can continue.

65' Play continues despite the shouts by some Union Berlin players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Sascha Stegemann interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
64' Surely that's handball by one of the Heidenheim players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
64' Union Berlin can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
61' Urs Fischer has decided to make a change. Paul Jaeckel (Union Berlin) replaces Diogo Leite.
59' 1 - 0 Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) produces a moment of pure magic and scores a spectacular goal by striking the ball into the top left corner of the net!
59' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
58' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) makes a strong challenge and Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Heidenheim.
58' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

57' Ambitious effort from Robin Gosens (Union Berlin). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
56' Heidenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
56' One of the Heidenheim players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
54' The ratio of the ball possession is 50:50.
51' The corner is swung in but Union Berlin can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
50' The resulting set piece from Heidenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
49' Oh, what a chance! Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) was quickest to the rebound but the ball hit the left post.
48' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is yellow-carded.
47' Sascha Stegemann couldn't ignore the rough tackle by David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) and blew his whistle. That's a free kick to Heidenheim.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Sascha Stegemann has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) finds space near the penalty spot to plant a header at goal from the corner, but it's badly directed and drifts well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
44' There's an opportunity for Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
40' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Sascha Stegemann ignores the protests.
39' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) produces a header from long distance, but his naive attempt ends way wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
38' Union Berlin failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

37' Alex Kral (Union Berlin) gets inside the box and tries to beat Kevin Muller with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. The ball is out of play. Union Berlin will have a chance to score from a corner.
34' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

34' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Kevin Muller easily deals with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick.

32' David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Kevin Muller!
32' Heidenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
31' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
29' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
29' Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play. Heidenheim are awarded a corner kick.
27' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) sends a long ball in, but Frederik Ronnow comfortably gathers the ball.
26' A pass from Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) is intercepted by Kevin Muller and the move breaks down.
22' David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.

21' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Union Berlin win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.

20' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom left corner lacks power and Frederik Ronnow easily makes the save.
18' Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul after Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

16' A rebound falls to Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
15' David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Kevin Muller.
15' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
13' Flag goes up against Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
13' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Union Berlin comes to nothing.
12' The ball is cleared after Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Union Berlin force their opponents to concede a corner.

10' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
9' A pass by Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
8' Heidenheim fail to score from a corner as Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin) leaps to collect the ball.
8' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Now Heidenheim have a corner.
5' David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) misses a sitter as his shot goes over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.

5' Golden chance! Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
4' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) causes Frederik Ronnow little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Union Berlin will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Sascha Stegemann.
